column3: Chapter 2
CERTIFICATE
215C.  (1)  A  ship  shall  not  go  to  sea  on  a
voyage to or from any port or place in Sri Lanka
or  any  Sri  Lanka  ship  shall  not  perform  an
international  voyage,  unless  there  is  in  force
in respect of the ship a certificate issued under
this Part.
(2) If any ship goes or attempts to go to sea
in contravention of subsection (1), the owner
or the master of the ship shall be guilty of an
offence  and  on  conviction  thereof,  shall  be
liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding
one year or to a fine not exceeding one hundred
thousand rupees or to both such imprisonment
and fine.
215D.  In  the  event  of  any  amendment  or

replacement  of  any  provisions  of 
the
Convention  affecting  the  nature  of  the
certificate referred to in subsection (1) of section
215C,  the  Minister  may  by  Order  direct  that
such  subsection  shall  have  effect  as  if  there
were  substituted  therefor  references  to  such
other certificate, appropriate to the Convention
as  so  amended,  as  the  Minister  may  by  such
order prescribe.
